annotations.title: Run a one-click effect on a photo

description: ONE-CLICK EFFECTS, the same ones as the /tools pages: a photo goes in, a styled picture comes out, and most can then become a 5-second clip. Plush toy, 3D figure, mascot, comic book, pixel game, billboard ad, giant product, bullet time, packshot, outfit swap, headshot, relight and many more. Name no `effect` for the free list. `effect` alone: what it takes. `effect` + `images`: a free quote; add confirm:true to make the picture. Then `effect` + `still` (that picture's URL): a free quote for the clip; confirm:true makes it. `describe` adds anything of your own. For a look not on the list use generate_image. A real person's photo follows the same likeness rules as every render.

confirm.description: true = run it (real spend); without it, a free quote

describe.description: your own words: added to the look, or the custom choice

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

images.description: its pictures, in the order listed: URL, local path or Library id

options.description: its listed options, e.g. {material:"knit"}; "custom" means use `describe`

speech.description: CLIP STEP: a line said in the clip, on an effect that speaks

still.description: CLIP STEP: the finished picture to animate

text.description: a line printed exactly, on an effect that takes one

name: make_effect
title: Run a one-click effect on a photo
